title: Edit an Existing Leave Request in Orange HRM website
description:
h3. *Description*

Navigate to an existing leave request (where permitted) and modify the leave dates or leave type, then save the changes.

h3. *Acceptance Criteria*

* User can navigate to the *Leave* module.
* User can locate an existing leave request that is eligible for modification.
* User can edit the leave request details (e.g., leave dates or leave type).
* User can save the updated leave request successfully.
* A success confirmation message is displayed.
* Updated leave details are reflected in the Leave List/History.
* No application errors or validation issues are encountered during the update.

{quote}*Note:* Depending on the OrangeHRM demo environment, editing an approved leave request may not be permitted. If editing is restricted, this scenario can be replaced with editing another entity such as a job vacancy or employee contact details.{quote}
